extraction_scope.policy: Only the target body is reconstructed. 0x00e30f90 and 0x00f47380 are declared as package-local function-pointer ports with inert defaults; neither helper is given a body, no field of the receiver is typed, and no layout knowledge from the destroy helper leaks into this package.

original_native_abi.frame: PUSH ESI / MOV ESI,ECX; receiver preserved in ESI across both calls; no stack frame is allocated

stack_arguments.note: the stack slot is one word wide but only its low byte is read; after PUSH ESI the slot is observed at ESP+0x8

original_native_abi.return_contract: the incoming ECX receiver, unchanged; MOV EAX,ESI at 0x00e310d8

interior_thunk.conclusion: the published entry is a thiscall thunk that rebases ECX by -0x8; 0x00e310c0 itself performs no receiver adjustment, so the returned EAX is the interior receiver it was handed and the caller's -0x8 is the outer view

ownership_search.overlap_resolution: The in-flight pkg-resource-state-wave10 package models this VA inside a wider destroy chain: it types the flag as a full Word, narrows it with a dword AND, and defines bodies for 0x00e30f90, 0x00f47380, 0x00e308d0 and 0x00571db0. This package extracts the target alone, reads the flag one byte at a time as the observed TEST does, and keeps both callees as dependency-only ports. Neither package was edited; the two records must be adjudicated at integration.

dependency_overlap.0x00e30f90: claimed only by reconstruction/staging/pkg-resource-state-wave10, which defines its body; this package holds a port only
dependency_overlap.0x00f47380: referenced as a shared release port by 62 staging files across the campaign and never given a body there; this package follows the same port-only treatment

abi_boundary_assertions: the entry emits exactly one return and it is RET 0x4
the entry performs exactly two port dispatches and no direct transfer other than its own position-independent base thunk
the only non frame memory the entry touches is one port record with two distinct slots, so no receiver field is read or written
the release flag is read one byte at a time from a frame slot and narrowed with 0x1 in exactly one place
a single forward conditional branch sits between the destroy dispatch and the release dispatch
symbolic origin tracking requires the returned EAX to originate from the incoming ECX receiver
